records.name: Flanders

rule.text: Open by default: non-motorised craft may use non-navigable rivers (BVR 7 May 2021, art. 21) and navigable waterways, apart from listed exceptions.
conditions: Never pass a lock on the water: portage around it.
On navigable waterways, keep clear of shipping and give way.

source.title: BVR of 7 May 2021 on non-navigable watercourses, art. 21

records.unverified: Whether water managers have banned paddling on particular rivers: there is no central list of such bans.

rule.text: Only stretches listed in the AGW of 19 March 2009 may be paddled, at set seasons, hours and flows. Water that is not a listed stretch is treated as not allowed.

source.title: AGW of 19 March 2009 on traffic on watercourses

rule.text: The canal is open with caveats, ponds need permission. packraft-go doesn't check Brussels waters yet.

source.title: Brussels police regulation for the canal and port (4 March 2010)
